qualification: Each candidate must pass full validation then its own locked qualification split at >=95% greedy exact-answer accuracy; no threshold relaxation
baseline: Approximately parameter-matched GRU with teacher's budget and sample order; n-grams 1,3,6. Baseline superiority is not required for qualification.
primary: A_transfer = exact accuracy(real_kd) - exact accuracy(real_ce), on locked unseen complete instances
test_lock: Freeze all cohort specs before training. Unlock only after every matched condition reaches the same budget. Never tune within a cohort using its final test.
positive_branch: If seed-zero A_transfer > 0, repeat the unchanged 512-update comparison across remaining seeds while time permits. A positive point estimate is only an exploratory lead.
negative_branch: If A_transfer <= 0, compare training-probe and validation behavior, run small-substrate diagnostics, then extend all three conditions together to 1024 and evaluate a separate locked extension test if time permits.
capacity_policy: Preplanned grid on induced biological subgraphs and matched degree rewiring; fixed data and budget. Report minimum observed successful substrate, never a global capacity bound. Add ER control and another qualified task when time permits.
deadline_policy: Do not interrupt an active matched cohort. Before starting a new one, use measured runtime to avoid an unfinished comparison by morning. Fill remaining time with bounded cheap diagnostics and independent teacher qualification, not extra tuning on the final test.
evidence_tier: Adaptive exploratory overnight research; no confirmatory claims from conditional task/seed selection
